name: Eternal Wardens
background:
Eternal Wardens are massive magically imbued soldiers equipped with heavy battle armour and deadly weapons. Few in number, they rely on armour and skill in battle to overcome more numerous foes. 

These powerful soldiers venture from the Voidgates of the Alabaster City to many Planes, including Tyria. They are famed for their diplomatic skill, heroic strength and hatred of Havoc. They recruit throughout the Planes, but only those who prove worthy learn the Wardens’ true purpose: sacrificing souls to protect their Plane from a far greater danger. Of course, unworthy souls will still find purpose in defending their Plane, by other means.
backgroundFull:
The Eternal Wardens hail from the Alabaster City, a bustling metropolis which stands in stark contrast to the ashen wasteland that makes up the rest of their realm. The city is a host to countless Voidgates that allow the Wardens to travel to countless Planes, including Tyria and many more beyond it. The largest Voidgate in the Alabaster City lies in its very heart, sealed by the Warden God who has dedicated his entire being to keeping the gate shut, stopping what lies beyond it from venturing in. 

There is no one alive who still knows the full truth of what lies beyond the gate, except for fragments of legend and speculation. All that is known for certain is that their God has dedicated his entire purpose to ensuring that the Voidgate remains shut. This task has slowly drained the Warden God’s power over the centuries, however, and the people of the city have long watched their God’s strength slowly fail. 

In order to preserve the Warden God, his followers sacrifice thousands of souls each day to lend him strength. His most devoted and skilled followers are inducted into the order of Eternal Wardens and imbued with a portion of their God’s power. The Wardens venture out into several Planes to find worthy sacrifices, and either bring them to the Alabaster city alive, or capture their souls in lanterns to feed to their God. 

During their travels, the Wardens discovered that a Havoc Daemon’s soul contains a portion of their god’s divine energy, and serves as a uniquely potent sacrifice for their own god. The Wardens started hunting Havoc Daemons through several Planes, eventually following the Havoc Gods to Tyria, arriving early in the Havoc Wars whilst pursuing the Havoc Gods. In Tyria, they helped win many battles, fighting alongside Tyrians and capturing many Daemons. When the Havoc Gods were sealed, the Eternal Wardens disappeared as suddenly as they came. 

Now that the Great Rift has opened, and the Havoc Gods have been freed, the Wardens have returned to Tyria, viewing it as a hunting ground for capturing Daemons. However, they are now more careful fighting Daemons, not wishing them to be as badly defeated as they were, so as not to lose their source of souls. When necessary, they will even fight with other Tyrian factions, just to make sure that the Havoc Daemons are not driven to extinction. 

How will you keep the gate sealed?

specialRules.name: Unwieldy
specialRules.description: Strikes last when charging.

specialRules.name: Repel Ambushers
specialRules.description: Enemy units using Ambush must be set up over 12" away from this model's unit.

specialRules.name: Infiltrate
specialRules.description: Counts as having Ambush, but may be deployed anywhere over 3" away from enemy unit.

specialRules.name: Vanguard
specialRules.description: After this model is deployed, it may be placed anywhere fully within 9" of its position, over 9" away from non-Vanguard enemy units.

specialRules.name: Stealth Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Stealth. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Sergeant
specialRules.description: This model gets AP(+1) when attacking.

specialRules.name: Armor
specialRules.description: Counts as having Defense X+.

specialRules.name: Bane when Shooting
specialRules.description: This model gets Bane when shooting.

specialRules.name: Unstoppable in Melee Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Unstoppable in melee. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Bounding
specialRules.description: When this unit is activated, you may move all models with this rule in it by up to D3+1".

specialRules.name: Enhanced Warden Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Enhanced Warden. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Re-Deployment
specialRules.description: After all other units are deployed (excluding units that were set aside), you may remove up to two friendly units from the table and deploy them again. Players alternate in placing Re-Deployment units, starting with the player that activates next.

specialRules.name: Brace in Melee
specialRules.description: This model gets Brace(1) in melee.

specialRules.name: Warden
specialRules.description: When units where most models have this rule take hits, those hits count as having AP(-1), to a min. of AP(0).

specialRules.name: Enhanced Warden
specialRules.description: If most models in this unit have Warden, hits they take count as having AP(-2) from Warden (instead of only AP(-1)).

specialRules.name: Piercing Target
specialRules.description: Once per game, during this model's activation, pick X enemy units within 18" and in line of sight of it, and place one token on them. Friendly units get AP(+1) on their weapons when attacking them.

specialRules.name: Melee Slayer
specialRules.description: When charging, this model's weapons get AP(+2) if most models in the target have Tough(9) or higher.

specialRules.name: Ignores Regeneration
specialRules.description: This weapon ignores Regeneration.

specialRules.name: Smash
specialRules.description: When attacking units over half of this weapon's range away, the target must re-roll unmodified Defense results of 6.

specialRules.name: Unpredictable Fighter
specialRules.description: When in melee, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1), and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.

specialRules.name: Bane when Shooting Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Bane when shooting. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Fortified
specialRules.description: When units where most models have this rule take hits, those hits count as having AP(-1), to a min. of AP(0).

specialRules.name: Enhanced Fortified
specialRules.description: If most models in this unit have Fortified, hits they take count as having AP(-2) from Fortified (instead of only AP(-1)).

specialRules.name: Ambush
specialRules.description: May be set aside before deployment. At the start of any round after the first, may be deployed anywhere over 9” away from enemy units. Players alternate in placing Ambush units, starting with the player that activates next. Units that deploy via Ambush can’t seize or contest objectives on the round they deploy.

specialRules.name: Stealth
specialRules.description: When units where most models have this rule are shot from over 9" away, enemy units get -1 to hit rolls.

specialRules.name: AP
specialRules.description: Targets get -X to Defense rolls when blocking hits.

specialRules.name: Defense
specialRules.description: This model gets +X to Defense rolls.

specialRules.name: Bane
specialRules.description: Ignores Regeneration, and when attacking, the target must re-roll unmodified Defense results of 6.

specialRules.name: Unstoppable
specialRules.description: Ignores Regeneration, and ignores all negative modifiers to this weapon which are not from this model's special rules.

specialRules.name: Brace
specialRules.description: Enemies charging this unit get -X total Impact rolls, unless this unit is Fatigued.

specialRules.name: Tough
specialRules.description: Once a model has taken as many wounds as its Tough value, it is killed (remove from play).

specialRules.name: Regeneration
specialRules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 5+ it is ignored.

specialRules.name: Shred
specialRules.description: For each unmodified result of 1 to block hits, this weapon deals 1 extra wound.
